minutes-of-meeting-format.8: Notice: every decision is one sentence, and every action has 1 owner and 1 date. That is what makes minutes useful a month later.
minutes-of-meeting-format.13: Colleges and schools: keep the standard 8-part format and add the committee name and the academic year. Common ones: staff, IQAC, department, PTA and student council meetings.
minutes-of-meeting-format.24: The standard format has 8 parts: heading, date, time and venue, attendance, agenda, discussion, decisions, action items with owner and deadline, and next meeting details with signature. Copy the template above into Word or Google Docs, and save it, so every meeting starts from an identical structure.
